_doc: Static stack-bound gate for the C6 netstack player (//firmware/player_app:stack_bound_test, tool //tools/stack_bound). Each root's worst case over the ELF call graph, plus isr_context_bytes, times margin must fit its reserved stack, read from the source. Edit this file only with a reason next to the entry.
_noreturn: Callees that never return, so their stack use only changes HOW an already-fatal error presents: Rust panics, and C++ throws (the only catch handlers in the image are libstdc++'s nothrow operator new, so every throw unwinds into std::terminate -> abort).
_indirect_edges: Function-pointer calls the disassembly can't resolve: mbedtls's f_send/f_recv are our bio callbacks (netstack_transport.cpp mbedtls_ssl_set_bio).
_dynamic_allocations: VLA/alloca bytes per function. Preferences::getString: a char[len+1] for the stored NVS string (our values are names/credentials, <= 64 B). ppTxFragmentProc (libpp): a buffer of roundup2(fragment) bytes, the fragment bounded by the 2346 B fragmentation threshold.
_accepted_cycles: Recursion inside prebuilt/vendor code (error/retry paths), taken as one level deep. A NEW cycle fails the gate.
